activities.title: Intrinsic Dimensionality and Low-Rank Matrix Factorization

source_resources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
source_resources.author: Edward J. Hu, Yelong Shen, Phillip Wallis, Zeyuan Allen-Zhu, Yuanzhi Li, Shean Wang, Lu Wang, Weizhu Chen
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful academic reference under arXiv open access terms.
source_resources.prerequisites: Matrix factorization, rank, linear layers, and transformer attention.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Primary literature introducing Low-Rank Adaptation, establishing parameter decomposition W = W0 + (alpha/r)*BA, initialization strategies, and zero inference latency merging.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Complete matrix derivations, tensor dimensions, and pure PyTorch LoRALinear modules are implemented directly in lesson code.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Houlsby et al. Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning for NLP (Series Adapters)
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Introduces bottleneck adapter layers in series, which introduces unavoidable inference latency overhead; LoRA's parallel formulation merges with zero latency.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Li & Liang: Prefix-Tuning: Optimizing Continuous Prompts for Generation
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Prepends virtual prompt tokens; reduces available context length, unlike LoRA which preserves full sequence capacity.

source_resources.relevant_timestamp: Section 4.1 Low-Rank-Parametrized Update Matrices; Section 7.2 What Is the Optimal Rank r for LoRA?

source_resources.title: Intrinsic Dimensionality Explains the Effectiveness of Language Model Fine-Tuning
source_resources.author: Armen Aghajanyan, Luke Zettlemoyer, Sonal Gupta
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful academic reference under arXiv open access terms.
source_resources.prerequisites: Linear algebra, matrix subspace projection, and pretraining representations.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Key theoretical foundation demonstrating that overparameterized pre-trained language models reside on a low-dimensional manifold, proving why low rank r (e.g. 4 to 16) is sufficient for task adaptation.
source_resources.safe_fallback: The intrinsic dimensionality concept, subspace projections, and parameter reduction trade-offs are fully explained in lesson text.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Li et al. Measuring the Intrinsic Dimension of Objective Landscapes (ICLR 2018)
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: General neural network optimization landscapes; Aghajanyan focuses explicitly on foundation language models.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Biderman et al. LoRA Learns Less and Forgets Less
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Measures how low-rank LoRA trades target-domain learning for less forgetting; Aghajanyan provides the direct theoretical motivation for LoRA's low-rank assumption.

source_resources.title: PEFT: State-of-the-art Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Methods
source_resources.author: Sourab Mangrulkar, Sylvain Gugger, Lysandre Debut, Younes Belkada, Sayak Paul, Benjamin Bossan
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external reference under Apache-2.0 open-source terms.
source_resources.prerequisites: PyTorch nn.Module, Hugging Face transformers, and LoRA equations.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Widely adopted open-source library implementing LoRA configuration classes (LoraConfig), get_peft_model, and adapter serialization.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Standalone, zero-dependency PyTorch implementations of LoRALinear layers and save/reload logic are provided in curriculum scripts.

compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Original reference code by Hu et al.; PEFT expands this to broader multi-model ecosystem integration.
High-performance clean implementation; compared alongside PEFT for modular code architecture.

source_resources.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
source_resources.author: Tim Dettmers, Artidoro Pagnoni, Ari Holtzman, Luke Zettlemoyer
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful academic reference under arXiv open access terms.
source_resources.prerequisites: Quantization (NF4/FP4), double quantization, and standard LoRA.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Primary paper cited to clearly distinguish pure unquantized FP16/BF16 LoRA from 4-bit quantized QLoRA with paged optimizers, preventing misleading terminology conflation.
source_resources.safe_fallback: The mathematical distinction between LoRA adapter updates and 4-bit base weight dequantization is explicitly detailed in curriculum comparisons.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Frantar et al. GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Post-training quantization only; QLoRA combines backpropagation through quantized weights with LoRA adapters.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Lin et al. AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for LLM Compression and Acceleration
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Inference quantization; Dettmers QLoRA focuses specifically on parameter-efficient fine-tuning memory reduction.

source_resources.relevant_timestamp: Section 3 QLoRA Finetuning and Appendix G Memory Footprint
